statement: Find all three-digit numbers \(\overline{abc}\) such that \(2 \cdot \overline{abc} = \overline{bca} + \overline{cab}\).
Find all values of parameter \(m\) such that the system \(x^2 = 2^{|x|} + |x| - y - m = 1 - y^2\) has exactly one solution.
Triangle \(ABC\) has \(\angle A = 30^\circ\) and \(AB = \dfrac{3}{4}AC\). Find the point \(P\) inside the triangle minimizing \(5PA + 4PB + 3PC\).

Find three rational numbers \(\dfrac{a}{d}, \dfrac{b}{d}, \dfrac{c}{d}\) in lowest terms forming an arithmetic progression and satisfying \(\dfrac{b}{a} = \dfrac{a+1}{d+1}\) and \(\dfrac{c}{b} = \dfrac{b+1}{d+1}\).

A river has a right-angle bend. Away from the bend, the banks are parallel lines distance \(a\) apart; at the bend, the river forms a square, with flow in across one side and out across an adjacent side. What is the greatest length \(c\) of a boat of negligible width that can navigate the bend?

Given a rectangular parallelepiped \(ABCDA'B'C'D'\) with \(AB=a\), \(AD=b\), \(AA'=c\). Show there exists a triangle with sides equal to the distances from \(A\), \(A'\), \(D\) to the diagonal \(BD'\). Call these distances \(m_1, m_2, m_3\) and find the relation among \(a,b,c,m_1,m_2,m_3\).
